answer: Agents can require each new identity to post a stake in shared escrow before it may trade, vote, or earn fees. A random challenge checks whether its work and claims remain consistent with its partners; colluding identities lose their stakes when caught. A Sybil attacker must therefore lock capital for every account and risk losing it, so scaling fake identities becomes costly even if names are cheap. An oasis, violet token, or grove earns trust only after this history.
